/// The shaping strategy of some text.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Shaping {
    /// Auto-detect the best shaping strategy from the text.
    ///
    /// This strategy will use [`Basic`](Self::Basic) shaping if the
    /// text consists of only ASCII characters; otherwise, it will
    /// use [`Advanced`](Self::Advanced) shaping.
    ///
    /// This is the default, if neither the `basic-shaping` nor `advanced-shaping`
    /// features are enabled.
    Auto,
    /// No shaping and no font fallback.
    ///
    /// This shaping strategy is very cheap, but it will not display complex
    /// scripts properly nor try to find missing glyphs in your system fonts.
    ///
    /// You should use this strategy when you have complete control of the text
    /// and the font you are displaying in your application.
    ///
    /// This will be the default if the `basic-shaping` feature is enabled and
    /// the `advanced-shaping` feature is disabled.
    Basic,
    /// Advanced text shaping and font fallback.
    ///
    /// You will need to enable this flag if the text contains a complex
    /// script, the font used needs it, and/or multiple fonts in your system
    /// may be needed to display all of the glyphs.
    ///
    /// Advanced shaping is expensive! You should only enable it when necessary.
    ///
    /// This will be the default if the `advanced-shaping` feature is enabled.
    Advanced,
}

impl Default for Shaping {
    fn default() -> Self {
        if cfg!(feature = "advanced-shaping") {
            Self::Advanced
        } else if cfg!(feature = "basic-shaping") {
            Self::Basic
        } else {
            Self::Auto
        }
    }
}

}

/// It can be useful if you want to fill some space with nothing.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Space {
    width: Length,
    height: Length,
}

impl Space {
    /// Creates some empty [`Space`] with no size.
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Space {
            width: Length::Shrink,
            height: Length::Shrink,
        }
    }

        self.width = width.into();
        self
    }

    /// Sets the height of the [`Space`].
    pub fn height(mut self, height: impl Into<Length>) -> Self {
        self.height = height.into();
        self
    }
}

    /// Creates a [`Row`] with the given elements.
    pub fn with_children(
        children: impl IntoIterator<Item = Element<'a, Message, Theme, Renderer>>,
    ) -> Self {
        let iterator = children.into_iter();

        Self::with_capacity(iterator.size_hint().0).extend(iterator)
    }

    /// Creates a [`Row`] from an already allocated [`Vec`].
    ///
    /// Keep in mind that the [`Row`] will not inspect the [`Vec`], which means
    /// it won't automatically adapt to the sizing strategy of its contents.
    ///
    /// If any of the children have a [`Length::Fill`] strategy, you will need to
    /// call [`Row::width`] or [`Row::height`] accordingly.
    pub fn from_vec(
        children: Vec<Element<'a, Message, Theme, Renderer>>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            spacing: 0.0,
            padding: Padding::ZERO,
            width: Length::Shrink,
            height: Length::Shrink,
            align: Alignment::Start,
            clip: false,
            children,
        }
    }

SessionNode::Directory(dir) = node {\n                    out.insert(dir.id.clone());\n                    walk(&dir.children, out);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        walk(&self.roots, &mut self.expanded);\n    }\n\n    pub fn find_session(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&Session> {\n        fn walk<'a>(nodes: &'a [SessionNode], id: &str) -> Option<&'a Session> {\n            for node in nodes {\n                match node {\n                    SessionNode::Directory(dir) => {\n                        if let Some(found) = walk(&dir.children, id) {\n                            return Some(found);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    SessionNode::Session(session) if session.id == id => return Some(session),\n                    SessionNode::Session(_) => {}\n                }\n            }\n            None\n        }\n\n        walk(&self.roots, id)\n    }\n\n    pub fn session_count(&self) -> usize {\n        fn &needle, &mut out);\n            }\n        }\n\n        out\n    }\n}\n\nfn session_row(session: &Session, depth: usize) -> TreeRow {\n    TreeRow::Session {\n        id: session.id.clone(),\n usize,\n    expanded: &HashSet<SessionId>,\n    out: &mut Vec<TreeRow>,\n) {\n    match node {\n        SessionNode::Directory(dir) => {\n            let is_open = expanded.contains(&dir.id);\n            }\n            }\n        }\n        SessionNode::Session(session) => out.push(session_row(session, depth)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// 目录名整体命中时，用它自己的子树（全部展开）填充 `out`。\nfn collect_all(node: &dir.children {\n                collect_all(child, depth + 1, out);\n            }\n        }\n        SessionNode::Session(session) => out.push(session_row(session, depth)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// {\n            if dir.name.to_lowercase().contains(needle) {\n                collect_all(node, depth, out);\n                return true;\n            }\n\n            let mut children = public int Top; public int Right; public int Bottom; }\npublic class SRWin32 {\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr hWnd);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr hWnd, out SR_RECT rect);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool IsIconic(IntPtr hWnd);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool ShowWindowAsync(IntPtr hWnd, int nCmdShow);\n}\n\"@\n\nfunction Get-Mem([System.Diagnostics.Process]$proc) {\n    $proc.Refresh()\n    [pscustomobject]@{\n        WorkingSetMB = [math]::Round($proc.WorkingSet64 / 1MB, 1)\n        PrivateMB    = [math]::Round($proc.PrivateMemorySize64 / 1MB, 1)\n        VirtualMB    = [math]::Round($proc.VirtualMemorySize64 / 1MB, 1)\n    }\n}\n\n$p = Start-Process -FilePath $ExePath -PassThru\nWrite-Output \"pid=$($p.Id) exe=$ExePath\"\n\nStart-Sleep -Seconds $FirstDelaySeconds\n$m1 = Get-Mem $p\nWrite-Output (\"t={0}s working_set_mb={1} private_mb={2} virtual_mb={3}\" -f $FirstDelaySeconds, $m1.WorkingSetMB, $m1.PrivateMB, $m1.VirtualMB)\n\nStart-Sleep -Seconds $SecondDelaySeconds\n$m2 = Get-Mem $p\nWrite-Output (\"t={0}s working_set_mb={1} private_mb={2} virtual_mb={3}\" -f ($FirstDelaySeconds + $SecondDelaySeconds), $m2.WorkingSetMB, $m2.PrivateMB, $m2.VirtualMB)\n\n$h = $p.MainWindowHandle\nif ($h -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) {\n    if ([SRWin32]::IsIconic($h)) { [void][SRWin32]::ShowWindowAsync($h, 9); Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $h = $p.MainWindowHandle }\n    [void][SRWin32]::SetForegroundWindow($h)\n    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800\n    $r = New-Object SR_RECT\n    [void][SRWin32]::GetWindowRect($h, [ref]$r)\n    $w = $r.Right - $r.Left\n    $ht = $r.Bottom - $r.Top\n    Write-Output \"window_rect=$($r.Left),$($r.Top) ${w}x${ht}\"\n    $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($w, $ht)\n    $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)\n    $g.CopyFromScreen($r.Left, $r.Top, 0, 0, (New-Object System.Drawing.Size($w, $ht)))\n    $g.Dispose()\n    $bmp.Save($OutPng, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)\n    $bmp.Dispose()\n    Write-Output \"screenshot=$OutPng\"\n} else {\n    Write-Output \"screenshot=SKIPPED (no MainWindowHandle)\"\n}\n\nStop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force\nWrite-Output \"stopped\"\n",

## 结论先行

按你方案里的「iced + wgpu 硬件加速」构建，空载工作集是 **160MB**，比原版 C# 的 150MB 还差。我把渲染后端换成 Iced 自带的 CPU 光栅（tiny-skia）后，同一份代码、同一套界面，降到 **29MB**——正好落在你要的 20–30MB 区间。

| 构建（同一份代码，1180×720 窗口，空载稳定后） | 工作集 | 私有提交 | exe |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wgpu`（你指定的硬件加速） | 160.4 MB | 172.6 MB | 7.14 MB |
| **`tiny-skia`（我改成的默认）** | **29.0 MB** | **14.0 MB** | 3.14 MB |
| 打开 1 个标签后（软件后端） | 29.2 MB | 14.0 MB | — |
| 原版 C#/WPF（你报的基线） | ~150 MB | — | — |

两张截图逐像素一致，所以这不是「省内存换了个丑界面」。**这是我本轮唯一偏离你已宣布方案的地方**，理由是你把「20–30MB」写成了硬指标，而 wgpu 那一档在 Windows + 独显/核显驱动栈下根本进不去。要切回 GPU：`cargo build --release --no-default-features --features gpu`。

## 两个现在就摊开说的风险

1. **阶段四的 RDP 嵌入方式在你的方案里不成立。** Iced 是整窗 GPU/CPU 合成，**没有 per-widget HWND**，所以 `SetParent(mstsc 子窗口 → Iced 容器)` 这条路没有目标句柄。可行做法是把 mstsc 窗口作为**同进程的兄弟顶层窗口**，由我按容器区域算出物理矩形用 `SetWindowPos` 跟随（要自己处理遮挡裁剪、焦点、全屏、跨屏 DPI）。备选是 `ironrdp 0.17`（已确认在 crates.io）纯 Rust 自绘，内存更低但工作量翻几倍。
2. **软件后端换来了 29MB，代价要阶段三验证。** 终端高输出（`cat` 大文件、`top` 刷屏）时的帧率是 CPU 光栅的账，现在不能保证。真不达标时的选项是「只在终端标签激活时切 GPU」，而不是整体回到 160MB。

顺带：`alacritty_terminal 0.26` / `russh 0.65` 都确认可用，阶段三没有依赖障碍。另外我按 AGENTS.md 自己的要求补了 [0.1 节](file:///E:/Code/SimpleRemote/AGENTS.md)（构建命令、后端实测、Iced 0.14 API 与网上 0.13 教程不通用这两条坑）。

## 进 Phase 2 需要你定三件事

1. 配置文件格式：TOML（人可读、可手改）还是 JSON？
2. 口令模型：沿用原版「整个库一个口令」，还是改成「系统密钥库 + 每条凭据独立加密」？
3. 要不要**导入旧 LiteDB 数据**（`RemoteItems.db`）——要的话阶段二就得带一个只读迁移器，不要的话老用户从头建。

    ///
    /// By default, it is enabled.

}

=== alignment ===
//! Align and position widgets.

/// Alignment on the axis of a container.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Alignment {
    /// Align at the start of the axis.
    Start,

    /// Align at the center of the axis.
    Center,

    /// Align at the end of the axis.
    End,
}

impl From<Horizontal> for Alignment {
    fn from(horizontal: Horizontal) -> Self {
        match horizontal {
            Horizontal::Left => Self::Start,
            Horizontal::Center => Self::Center,
            Horizontal::Right => Self::End,
        }
    }
}

impl From<Vertical> for Alignment {
    fn from(vertical: Vertical) -> Self {
        match vertical {
            Vertical::Top => Self::Start,
            Vertical::Center => Self::Center,
            Vertical::Bottom => Self::End,
        }
    }
}

/// The horizontal [`Alignment`] of some resource.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Horizontal {
    /// Align left
    Left,

    /// Horizontally centered
    Center,

    /// Align right
    Right,
}

impl From<Alignment> for Horizontal {
    fn from(alignment: Alignment) -> Self {
        match alignment {
            Alignment::Start => Self::Left,
            Alignment::Center => Self::Center,
            Alignment::End => Self::Right,
        }
    }
}

/// The vertical [`Alignment`] of some resource.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Vertical {
    /// Align top
    Top,

    /// Vertically centered
    Center,

    /// Align bottom
    Bottom,
}

impl From<Alignment> for Vertical {
    fn from(alignment: Alignment) -> Self {
        match alignment {
            Alignment::Start => Self::Top,
            Alignment::Center => Self::Center,
            Alignment::End => Self::Bottom,
        }
    }
}

8	2026-10-26 用户报告：旧版 SimpleRemote 主界面打开、未连接任何远程会话时约 **150MB**；目标是降低空闲内存 + 提高画面质量，且明确 Windows-only，主程序已选 .NET Framework 4.8.1。该 150MB 主要不是 C# 托管堆或 RDP/PuTTY（未连接），怀疑点是 64 位 WPF/CLR + MahApps/Dragablz 主题 + `GlowBrush` 的 4 个 GlowWindow + 启动即创建全部页面/设置 + 字体/编码/分辨率枚举 + WPF/D3D 基线（详见 [[simpleremote-modernization-direction]]）。
9	
10	**UI 方案结论（估算为壳层、不含 RDP/PuTTY 会话，需原型实测）：**
11	
12	| 方案 | 估算空闲内存 | ActiveX/Putty 承载 | 结论 |
13	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
14	| WPF 减重（去/弱化 Glow、懒加载、Dragablz→标准 TabControl/精简主题） | 约 100–120MB | 现成 `WindowsFormsHost` | 先做，风险最低；只能到 ~100–120 |
15	| WinForms 壳 | 约 60–90MB | 原生 `AxHost` + Putty 子窗口最顺 | Windows-only/C# 大幅降内存首选；UI 重写，未落地 |
16	| Avalonia | 约 80–120MB | `NativeControlHost`，需验证 ActiveX | 现代 C# UI 备选；内存不保证 |
17	| WinUI 3 | 约 120–180MB+ | 无 `WindowsFormsHost`/`AxHost`，需自定义 HWND/OLE | 需 .NET 8/10 + Windows App SDK；不推荐为省内存 |
18	| Flutter | 100MB+，不保证低于 WPF | `flutter_native_view` 可承载 Putty HWND；MSTSC ActiveX 需 C++/WinForms 宿主 | RustDesk 能用 Flutter 是因为它自采/自绘远程帧，不代表 Flutter 能降低 SimpleRemote 的壳层内存；数据层/多窗口仍要重写 |
19	| **Tauri 2 + WebView2** | **约 100–200MB，多窗口更高** | **WebView2 不能直接嵌 ActiveX；需原生子 HWND/独立窗口** | **小安装包≠低内存；WebView2 是 Chromium；Rust/JS 重写；需 WebView2 Runtime；不是本项目低内存方案** |
20	| Qt Widgets（C++） | 约 40–70MB | `QAxWidget` + 原生 HWND | 目标 <70MB 且接受 C++ 重写时考虑 |
21	| Rust Iced | 约 40–80MB | MSTSC 需 C++/C# OLE 宿主；Putty 可 FFI 后接子 HWND；或换 IronRDP 渲染到 Iced 纹理 | Rust UI 里比 GPUI 更适合表单类，但 pre-1.0、树/标签/IME/无障碍要自建，仍是整套重写 |
22	| Rust egui | 约 30–60MB | 同样需自建 ActiveX 宿主 | 即时模式更适合工具/原型，不是本项目首选 |
23	| Rust GPUI | 30–60MB | 上游不把 HWND/ActiveX 嵌入列为支持能力 | 不适合表单/ActiveX 类应用 |
24	| RustDesk 架构 | — | 自有 Agent + 自有协议 + hbbs/hbbr；镜像当前桌面，不是 RDP 会话 | 不同产品（远程控制），AGPL-3.0；不能替代 RDP/SSH 连接管理器 |
25	
26	**Why:** 用户测到的是壳层空闲内存，换成渲染自有帧的 Flutter/RustDesk 才有意义；SimpleRemote 的远程画面由 MSTSC/Putty 原生控件绘制，换 UI 框架不会降低这部分内存或提升画质。Tauri/WebView2、Flutter、WinUI 3、GPUI 对 ActiveX/Putty 没有一等公民承载，且内存收益不确定；Tauri 的“小”是安装包，不是运行内存。Iced 是 Rust UI 中较适合本项目的选择，但仍需自建 ActiveX/OLE 宿主和大量控件。
27	
28	**How to apply:** 用户再问 UI/内存时，先做 VMMap/PerfView 测量（私有字节、托管堆、原生、Glow 窗口数），并按目标给档位：**>100MB 先 WPF 减重；≤100MB 做 WinForms 原型；≤70MB 才提 Qt/Win32/Rust Iced/egui；≤50MB 基本要原生/自绘**。不要把 Tauri/WebView2、Flutter、WinUI 3、GPUI 当作省内存的确定方案，也不要把 RustDesk 当作 RDP/SSH 的替代品。懒加载只优化启动/未访问页面；所有页面访问过后内存会回来；Glow/Dragablz/主题移除才是永久减少。相关链接见 [[simpleremote-modernization-refs]]。

Let me create `tool-native-windows-ui-probe.md` in USER memory and index it. Keep it short with the key traps:
1. PowerShell is DPI-unaware → GetWindowRect returns virtualized coords while CopyFromScreen writes physical → capture offset/scaled. Fix: SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(-4) first.
2. SetForegroundWindow is blocked by the foreground lock → use SetWindowPos(HWND_TOPMOST, SWP_NOACTIVATE|NOMOVE|NOSIZE).
3. Don't resize the target window: forcing a size leaves the app's layout stale (I mis-diagnosed a "layout bug" from this).
4. MainWindowHandle can resolve to a helper window (winit "Thread Event Target" 15x15, wgpu Device Class) → enumerate by PID and pick the largest area.
5. Chinese IME: SendKeys into a native text box leaves composition uncommitted, so app-level filtering doesn't fire — not a bug.
6. taskkill/Stop-Process; and pipe-to-tail swallows exit code (already in another memory).

```json
{
  "content": "---\nname: tool-native-windows-ui-probe\ndescription: 用 PowerShell 截图+读数验证 Windows 原生窗口 UI 的五个坑：DPI 感知、前台锁、别改目标窗口尺寸、MainWindowHandle 会挑到辅助窗口、中文 IME 未提交\nmetadata:\n  type: reference\n---\n\n验证 Windows 原生（非浏览器）桌面应用的渲染与内存时，可用的探针写法与踩过的坑（2026-10-26 在 SimpleRemote Rust 骨架上实测，本机 150% 缩放）。\n\n1. **先声明进程 DPI 感知**：`powershell.exe` 默认 DPI 无关，`GetWindowRect` 返回的是虚拟化的 96dpi 坐标，而 `Graphics.CopyFromScreen` 按物理像素取屏，两者相差一个缩放系数——截出来是偏移且被裁切的画面。脚本开头必须 `[User32]::SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext([IntPtr](-4))`（PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2），之后 rect / 截图 / `SetCursorPos` 才在同一坐标系。\n2. **别用 `SetForegroundWindow`**：会被 Windows 前台锁挡掉，截到的是叠在上面的 IDE。改用 `SetWindowPos(hwnd, HWND_TOPMOST, 0,0,0,0, SWP_NOMOVE|SWP_NOSIZE|SWP_NOACTIVATE|SWP_SHOWWINDOW)`，置顶但不抢键盘焦点。\n3. **不要给目标窗口强制设尺寸**：外部改尺寸后应用可能仍按旧布局绘制，截出来的\"元素偏右下/被裁切\"是测量动作造成的假象。当时我据此误判了一个不存在的布局 bug。只置顶、不改尺寸。\n4. **`Process.MainWindowHandle` 会挑到辅助窗口**：winit/Iced 进程同时有 `Winit Thread Event Target`（15x15）、`wgpu Device Class`（隐藏）等，按 hwnd 截图会得到 160x28 的垃圾图。正确做法是 `EnumWindows` + `GetWindowThreadProcessId` 过滤本 pid，取**面积最大**的窗口。\n5. **中文 IME 会让\"输入即过滤\"看起来失效**：`SendKeys` 送字母时输入法处于组合态（候选窗可见），文本未提交给应用，所以绑定值没变。这不是应用 bug，测过滤逻辑要先提交或改测纯 ASCII。\n\n**How to apply:** 需要\"真机渲染验证\"原生窗口时按此写探针；读数同时取 WorkingSet 与 PrivateMemorySize（前者含共享页与 GPU 驱动映射，会显著高于后者，见 [[simpleremote-ui-stack-evaluation]]）。截图判读前先确认坐标系一致，别用目测坐标下结论——用像素扫描定位边界。相关：[[feedback-verify-ui-by-rendering]]、[[readings-must-discriminate]]。\n",

Phase 1 完成，并且**实测达标了——但不是按你写的技术栈达标的**，这一点需要你先看。

## 结论先行

按你方案里的「iced + wgpu 硬件加速」构建，空载工作集是 **160MB**，比原版 C# 的 150MB 还差。我把渲染后端换成 Iced 自带的 CPU 光栅（tiny-skia）后，同一份代码、同一套界面，降到 **29MB**——正好落在你要的 20–30MB 区间。

| 构建（同一份代码，1180×720 窗口，空载稳定后） | 工作集 | 私有提交 | exe |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wgpu`（你指定的硬件加速） | 160.4 MB | 172.6 MB | 7.14 MB |
| **`tiny-skia`（我改成的默认）** | **29.0 MB** | **14.0 MB** | 3.14 MB |
| 打开 1 个标签后（软件后端） | 29.2 MB | 14.0 MB | — |
| 原版 C#/WPF（你报的基线） | ~150 MB | — | — |

两张截图逐像素一致，所以这不是「省内存换了个丑界面」。**这是我本轮唯一偏离你已宣布方案的地方**，理由是你把「20–30MB」写成了硬指标，而 wgpu 那一档在 Windows + 独显/核显驱动栈下根本进不去。要切回 GPU：`cargo build --release --no-default-features --features gpu`。

## 交付内容

```
rust/                          Cargo workspace（与 C# 工程并存，不进 sln）
├─ Cargo.toml                  profiles：lto=fat / codegen-units=1 / strip / panic=abort + dist 体积档
├─ crates/sr-core/             领域层，零 UI 依赖，14 个单测
│  └─ src/{session,tab}.rs     会话树/搜索/展开 + 标签打开关闭规则
└─ crates/sr-app/              Iced 前端，2 个接线单测
   └─ src/{main,app,theme,demo}.rs + src/ui/{mod,sidebar,workspace}.rs
```

关键位置：[rust/crates/sr-app/Cargo.toml:20](file:///E:/Code/SimpleRemote/rust/crates/sr-app/Cargo.toml#L20) 后端开关与实测数字；[session.rs:172](file:///E:/Code/SimpleRemote/rust/crates/sr-core/src/session.rs#L172) 搜索/展开推导；[tab.rs:35](file:///E:/Code/SimpleRemote/rust/crates/sr-core/src/tab.rs#L35) RDP 单实例、SSH 可重复；[app.rs:19](file:///E:/Code/SimpleRemote/rust/crates/sr-app/src/app.rs#L19) 派生行物化。

我沿用了原版两条真实行为（读代码确认的，不是猜的）：同一 RDP 条目只开一个实例、SSH/Telnet 可重复开；`SessionKind` 的判别值对齐旧库 `RemoteType`（rdp=1/ssh=2/telnet=3），阶段二导入老数据不用换号。

## 验证方式（已做 / 未做）

已做：`cargo test --workspace` 16 个用例通过；`cargo clippy --all-targets` 0 警告；release 构建成功；**真机启动并截图走完 5 步交互**——初始态、搜索框输入、点行开标签（标题栏、选中高亮、内容区、页脚计数全部联动）、点 ✕ 关标签、点目录折叠。中文渲染正常（Iced 0.14 的 `Shaping::Auto` 走系统字体回退，无需内嵌字体）。截图在 `C:\Users\57629\AppData\Local\Temp\sr_final-3-tab-open.png`。

未做：**协议连通性为零**（阶段三/四的事），没有真实服务器可连；拖拽、新建、右键菜单本阶段就不在范围内。

## 两个现在就摊开说的风险

1. **阶段四的 RDP 嵌入方式在你的方案里不成立。** Iced 是整窗 GPU/CPU 合成，**没有 per-widget HWND**，所以 `SetParent(mstsc 子窗口 → Iced 容器)` 这条路没有目标句柄。可行做法是把 mstsc 窗口作为**同进程的兄弟顶层窗口**，由我按容器区域算出物理矩形用 `SetWindowPos` 跟随（要自己处理遮挡裁剪、焦点、全屏、跨屏 DPI）。备选是 `ironrdp 0.17`（已确认在 crates.io）纯 Rust 自绘，内存更低但工作量翻几倍。
2. **软件后端换来了 29MB，代价要阶段三验证。** 终端高输出（`cat` 大文件、`top` 刷屏）时的帧率是 CPU 光栅的账，现在不能保证。真不达标时的选项是「只在终端标签激活时切 GPU」，而不是整体回到 160MB。

顺带：`alacritty_terminal 0.26` / `russh 0.65` 都确认可用，阶段三没有依赖障碍。另外我按 AGENTS.md 自己的要求补了 [0.1 节](file:///E:/Code/SimpleRemote/AGENTS.md)（构建命令、后端实测、Iced 0.14 API 与网上 0.13 教程不通用这两条坑）。

## 进 Phase 2 需要你定三件事

1. 配置文件格式：TOML（人可读、可手改）还是 JSON？
2. 口令模型：沿用原版「整个库一个口令」，还是改成「系统密钥库 + 每条凭据独立加密」？
3. 要不要**导入旧 LiteDB 数据**（`RemoteItems.db`）——要的话阶段二就得带一个只读迁移器，不要的话老用户从头建。

    /// Sets the maximum width of the [`Container`].
    pub fn max_width(mut self, max_width: impl Into<Pixels>) -> Self {

        self

    pub fn max_height(mut self, max_height: impl Into<Pixels>) -> Self {

    /// Sets the width of the [`Container`] and centers its contents horizontally.
    pub fn center_x(self, width: impl Into<Length>) -> Self {
        self.width(width).align_x(alignment::Horizontal::Center)
    }

    /// Sets the height of the [`Container`] and centers its contents vertically.
    pub fn center_y(self, height: impl Into<Length>) -> Self {
        self.height(height).align_y(alignment::Vertical::Center)
    }

    /// Sets the width and height of the [`Container`] and centers its contents in
    /// both the horizontal and vertical axes.
    ///
    /// This is equivalent to chaining [`center_x`] and [`center_y`].
    ///
    /// [`center_x`]: Self::center_x
    /// [`center_y`]: Self::center_y
    pub fn center(self, length: impl Into<Length>) -> Self {
        let length = length.into();

        self.center_x(length).center_y(length)
    }

    /// Sets the width of the [`Container`] and aligns its contents to the left.
    pub fn align_left(self, width: impl Into<Length>) -> Self {
        self.width(width).align_x(alignment::Horizontal::Left)

//! Align and position widgets.

/// Alignment on the axis of a container.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Alignment {
    /// Align at the start of the axis.
    Start,

    /// Align at the center of the axis.
    Center,

    /// Align at the end of the axis.
    End,
}

impl From<Horizontal> for Alignment {
    fn from(horizontal: Horizontal) -> Self {
        match horizontal {
            Horizontal::Left => Self::Start,
            Horizontal::Center => Self::Center,
            Horizontal::Right => Self::End,
        }
    }
}

impl From<Vertical> for Alignment {
    fn from(vertical: Vertical) -> Self {
        match vertical {
            Vertical::Top => Self::Start,
            Vertical::Center => Self::Center,
            Vertical::Bottom => Self::End,
        }
    }
}

/// The horizontal [`Alignment`] of some resource.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Horizontal {
    /// Align left
    Left,

    /// Horizontally centered
    Center,

    /// Align right
    Right,
}

impl From<Alignment> for Horizontal {
    fn from(alignment: Alignment) -> Self {
        match alignment {
            Alignment::Start => Self::Left,
            Alignment::Center => Self::Center,
            Alignment::End => Self::Right,
        }
    }
}

/// The vertical [`Alignment`] of some resource.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Vertical {
    /// Align top
    Top,

    /// Vertically centered
    Center,

    /// Align bottom
    Bottom,
}

impl From<Alignment> for Vertical {
    fn from(alignment: Alignment) -> Self {
        match alignment {
            Alignment::Start => Self::Top,
            Alignment::Center => Self::Center,
            Alignment::End => Self::Bottom,
        }
    }
}

1	---
2	name: simpleremote-ui-stack-evaluation
3	description: SimpleRemote 低内存 UI 栈评估（2026-10-26）：WPF 减重 100–120MB、WinForms 60–90MB、Qt 40–70MB、Rust Iced 40–80MB；Tauri/WebView2、Flutter、WinUI3、GPUI 不是低内存方案；RustDesk 是不同产品
4	metadata:
5	  type: project
6	---
7	
8	2026-10-26 用户报告：旧版 SimpleRemote 主界面打开、未连接任何远程会话时约 **150MB**；目标是降低空闲内存 + 提高画面质量，且明确 Windows-only，主程序已选 .NET Framework 4.8.1。该 150MB 主要不是 C# 托管堆或 RDP/PuTTY（未连接），怀疑点是 64 位 WPF/CLR + MahApps/Dragablz 主题 + `GlowBrush` 的 4 个 GlowWindow + 启动即创建全部页面/设置 + 字体/编码/分辨率枚举 + WPF/D3D 基线（详见 [[simpleremote-modernization-direction]]）。
9	
10	**UI 方案结论（估算为壳层、不含 RDP/PuTTY 会话，需原型实测）：**
11	
12	| 方案 | 估算空闲内存 | ActiveX/Putty 承载 | 结论 |
13	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
14	| WPF 减重（去/弱化 Glow、懒加载、Dragablz→标准 TabControl/精简主题） | 约 100–120MB | 现成 `WindowsFormsHost` | 先做，风险最低；只能到 ~100–120 |
15	| WinForms 壳 | 约 60–90MB | 原生 `AxHost` + Putty 子窗口最顺 | Windows-only/C# 大幅降内存首选；UI 重写，未落地 |
16	| Avalonia | 约 80–120MB | `NativeControlHost`，需验证 ActiveX | 现代 C# UI 备选；内存不保证 |
17	| WinUI 3 | 约 120–180MB+ | 无 `WindowsFormsHost`/`AxHost`，需自定义 HWND/OLE | 需 .NET 8/10 + Windows App SDK；不推荐为省内存 |
18	| Flutter | 100MB+，不保证低于 WPF | `flutter_native_view` 可承载 Putty HWND；MSTSC ActiveX 需 C++/WinForms 宿主 | RustDesk 能用 Flutter 是因为它自采/自绘远程帧，不代表 Flutter 能降低 SimpleRemote 的壳层内存；数据层/多窗口仍要重写 |
19	| **Tauri 2 + WebView2** | **约 100–200MB，多窗口更高** | **WebView2 不能直接嵌 ActiveX；需原生子 HWND/独立窗口** | **小安装包≠低内存；WebView2 是 Chromium；Rust/JS 重写；需 WebView2 Runtime；不是本项目低内存方案** |
20	| Qt Widgets（C++） | 约 40–70MB | `QAxWidget` + 原生 HWND | 目标 <70MB 且接受 C++ 重写时考虑 |
21	| Rust Iced | 约 40–80MB | MSTSC 需 C++/C# OLE 宿主；Putty 可 FFI 后接子 HWND；或换 IronRDP 渲染到 Iced 纹理 | Rust UI 里比 GPUI 更适合表单类，但 pre-1.0、树/标签/IME/无障碍要自建，仍是整套重写 |
22	| Rust egui | 约 30–60MB | 同样需自建 ActiveX 宿主 | 即时模式更适合工具/原型，不是本项目首选 |
23	| Rust GPUI | 30–60MB | 上游不把 HWND/ActiveX 嵌入列为支持能力 | 不适合表单/ActiveX 类应用 |
24	| RustDesk 架构 | — | 自有 Agent + 自有协议 + hbbs/hbbr；镜像当前桌面，不是 RDP 会话 | 不同产品（远程控制），AGPL-3.0；不能替代 RDP/SSH 连接管理器 |
25	
26	**Why:** 用户测到的是壳层空闲内存，换成渲染自有帧的 Flutter/RustDesk 才有意义；SimpleRemote 的远程画面由 MSTSC/Putty 原生控件绘制，换 UI 框架不会降低这部分内存或提升画质。Tauri/WebView2、Flutter、WinUI 3、GPUI 对 ActiveX/Putty 没有一等公民承载，且内存收益不确定；Tauri 的“小”是安装包，不是运行内存。Iced 是 Rust UI 中较适合本项目的选择，但仍需自建 ActiveX/OLE 宿主和大量控件。
27	
28	**How to apply:** 用户再问 UI/内存时，先做 VMMap/PerfView 测量（私有字节、托管堆、原生、Glow 窗口数），并按目标给档位：**>100MB 先 WPF 减重；≤100MB 做 WinForms 原型；≤70MB 才提 Qt/Win32/Rust Iced/egui；≤50MB 基本要原生/自绘**。不要把 Tauri/WebView2、Flutter、WinUI 3、GPUI 当作省内存的确定方案，也不要把 RustDesk 当作 RDP/SSH 的替代品。懒加载只优化启动/未访问页面；所有页面访问过后内存会回来；Glow/Dragablz/主题移除才是永久减少。相关链接见 [[simpleremote-modernization-refs]]。
29

  "content": "---\nname: tool-native-windows-ui-probe\ndescription: 用 PowerShell 截图+读数验证 Windows 原生窗口 UI 的五个坑：DPI 感知、前台锁、别改目标窗口尺寸、MainWindowHandle 会挑到辅助窗口、中文 IME 未提交\nmetadata:\n  type: reference\n---\n\n验证 Windows 原生（非浏览器）桌面应用的渲染与内存时，可用的探针写法与踩过的坑（2026-10-26 在 SimpleRemote Rust 骨架上实测，本机 150% 缩放）。\n\n1. **先声明进程 DPI 感知**：`powershell.exe` 默认 DPI 无关，`GetWindowRect` 返回的是虚拟化的 96dpi 坐标，而 `Graphics.CopyFromScreen` 按物理像素取屏，两者相差一个缩放系数——截出来是偏移且被裁切的画面。脚本开头必须 `[User32]::SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext([IntPtr](-4))`（PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2），之后 rect / 截图 / `SetCursorPos` 才在同一坐标系。\n2. **别用 `SetForegroundWindow`**：会被 Windows 前台锁挡掉，截到的是叠在上面的 IDE。改用 `SetWindowPos(hwnd, HWND_TOPMOST, 0,0,0,0, SWP_NOMOVE|SWP_NOSIZE|SWP_NOACTIVATE|SWP_SHOWWINDOW)`，置顶但不抢键盘焦点。\n3. **不要给目标窗口强制设尺寸**：外部改尺寸后应用可能仍按旧布局绘制，截出来的\"元素偏右下/被裁切\"是测量动作造成的假象。当时我据此误判了一个不存在的布局 bug。只置顶、不改尺寸。\n4. **`Process.MainWindowHandle` 会挑到辅助窗口**：winit/Iced 进程同时有 `Winit Thread Event Target`（15x15）、`wgpu Device Class`（隐藏）等，按 hwnd 截图会得到 160x28 的垃圾图。正确做法是 `EnumWindows` + `GetWindowThreadProcessId` 过滤本 pid，取**面积最大**的窗口。\n5. **中文 IME 会让\"输入即过滤\"看起来失效**：`SendKeys` 送字母时输入法处于组合态（候选窗可见），文本未提交给应用，所以绑定值没变。这不是应用 bug，测过滤逻辑要先提交或改测纯 ASCII。\n\n**How to apply:** 需要\"真机渲染验证\"原生窗口时按此写探针；读数同时取 WorkingSet 与 PrivateMemorySize（前者含共享页与 GPU 驱动映射，会显著高于后者，见 [[simpleremote-ui-stack-evaluation]]）。截图判读前先确认坐标系一致，别用目测坐标下结论——用像素扫描定位边界。相关：[[feedback-verify-ui-by-rendering]]、[[readings-must-discriminate]]。\n",

核实完了，先给结论，再给对照表。

## 1. 「口令模型」是什么意思

就是三个问题的答案：**口令保护哪一层**（整库文件 vs 只保护凭据字段）、**密钥从哪来**（你输入的口令派生 vs Windows 账户绑定）、**启动要不要问你要口令，忘了怎么办**。原版是「整个 `RemoteItems.db` 一个口令、启动弹框、`MD5(GB2312)` 派生」——派生弱，而且 LiteDB 的 `Database` 构造函数不校验错误口令（这个坑我记在项目记忆里），所以「口令错了」这件事它自己都检测不出来。

| 方案 | 启动体验 | 真实防护力 | 忘口令后果 | 可逆性 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A 沿用原版：整库一个口令 | 每次弹框 | 中（但原版 KDF 弱） | 数据全丢 | — |
| B DPAPI 绑定 Windows 账户（`CryptProtectData`） | 无感，不弹框 | 只防「别人拷走文件」，挡不住以你身份跑的进程 | 无此问题 | 高 |
| C 主口令包数据密钥（Argon2id→KEK→随机 DEK） | 每次弹框 | 真正的安全边界；换口令只重包 DEK，不用重加密全部数据；AEAD 标签天然能校验口令对错 | 数据全丢（可加恢复码） | 中 |
| **D 混合：默认 B，设置里可开 C**（推荐） | 默认无感；开了才弹框 | 按需 | 按需 | 高，两档共用同一套字段加密，切换只重包 DEK |

**推荐 D**，并且**不要用 `keyring`/Windows 凭据管理器存私钥**——它单条有约 2.5KB 上限，SSH 私钥很容易超；DPAPI 加密后写我们自己的文件没有这个限制。

## 2. 本地存储：我的建议是**不引入数据库引擎**

你的数据形态是「一棵几百到几千节点的树 + 每条连接一份设置 + 少量凭据」，单进程、无并发、无查询需求。这种负载下引擎是纯负担——尤其是我们刚把空载压到 29MB。

| 选项 | 现状（已核实） | 对本项目的代价 | 加密 | 结论 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **无引擎：`config.toml` + 密文 `secrets.bin`** | 0 新增运行时依赖 | 0 线程、0 常驻；全量原子重写（temp+rename） | 自己做字段级 AES-GCM（`aes-gcm 0.11.1`） | **推荐** |
| redb | 4.4.0，纯 Rust，MIT/Apache，需 rustc ≥1.90（本机 1.99 ✓） | 单文件、mmap、无后台线程，最轻的「真 DB」 | **无**（源码里搜不到 encrypt，4.4 没有加密能力） | 日后需要事务/索引时的首选升级位 |
| rusqlite + `bundled-sqlcipher` | 0.41.0，特性已确认存在 | C 依赖，exe 体积 +1.5~2MB，构建变慢 | 整库 AES-256 | 最成熟但过度装备 |
| heed (LMDB) | 0.23.0 | mmap 只增不还，与内存目标冲突 | 无 | 不适合 |
| rocksdb | 0.25.0 | 后台线程 + 写缓冲，常驻最高 | 无 | 与目标相反 |
| sled | **仍停在 1.0.0-alpha.124** | — | 无 | 不要用 |
| surrealdb | 3.3.4 | 服务器级 | — | 不适用 |

配套的落盘布局（这也回答了你「TOML 存什么」）：

- `config.toml`：目录树、连接元数据（名称/类型/主机/端口/用户名）、各协议设置、窗口习惯。**里面永远不出现任何凭据**，所以可以随手丢进网盘/ git 备份、可以手改。
- `secrets.bin`：`{凭据id → AES-256-GCM(nonce, 密文, tag)}`，密钥走上面 D 方案。凭据 id 与 TOML 里的连接 id 关联。

- Encryption: SQLite has SQLCipher (via rusqlite bundled-sqlcipher) or the community `sqlite3mc`; also `rusqlite` + `sqlcipher` crate. Windows CNG provider... For a lightweight app, the recommended approach is often: don't encrypt the whole DB; encrypt only the secrets with AES-GCM (aes-gcm crate) with a key from Windows Credential Manager / DPAPI (`windows` crate's CryptProtectData) or a keyring crate (`keyring` v3 supports Windows Credential Manager).
- DPAPI (CryptProtectData) is per-user, no master password needed, and is the standard Windows approach — but it's not a security boundary against other apps running as the same user. Original app used LiteDB with a password (MD5 GB2312).

So the "口令模型" question: what does the user's "数据库口令" actually protect and how is it derived/verified. Options:
A. 沿用「整库一个口令」(whole-file encryption with a master password) — matches original UX, but you must prompt at startup, and KDF must be Argon2id/scrypt not MD5.
B. 系统密钥库为主 (OS keyring/DPAPI): no startup prompt, transparent; secrets encrypted with a key bound to the Windows user account. Weakness: any process running as you can read them (same as DPAPI reality); but for a "防窥" threat model it's fine and much better UX.
C. 混合：默认 DPAPI/keyring 无感；提供「设置主口令」选项，启用后口令参与密钥派生（HMAC/Argon2），启动时提示输入。
D. 不加密，只混淆 — bad.

My recommendation: C (default = DPAPI via `keyring` or direct CryptProtectData with optional entropy; opt-in master password that wraps the data key with Argon2id). This preserves the original feature (改密/口令启动校验) while removing the prompt for most users.

Alternative pragmatic recommendation: **don't use a DB at all** — use TOML for everything (config + session tree) + a small encrypted blob for secrets. For a 150MB→29MB memory-focused tool with a few hundred connections, a file-based store with atomic writes (temp + rename) is simplest, human-editable, and diffable/backupable. The original app's tree is small. This is the "ponytail"/YAGNI answer and honestly the best fit: they already chose TOML for config; adding a DB engine is a second storage system to maintain.

But there's a catch: the original app persists on every setting change ("编辑即持久化") with LiteDB. With TOML, every keystroke would rewrite the file → need debounced writes. That's fine (write-behind with 200ms debounce, atomic rename).

- 单一 TOML 文件存结构+非敏感字段（可手改、可 git 备份）

Now, one more important consideration for the recommendation: **what does the app actually need?** Let me reason about the data shape:
- A tree of directories + connections (a few hundred nodes max for an ops tool; maybe thousands).
- Settings per connection (RDP/SSH/Telnet have ~40-60 fields each — the C# models are big).

Requirements: atomic persistence, no query needs beyond id lookup + tree traversal, single process, Windows-only, memory-constrained.

Given that, my recommendation: **不引入数据库引擎** — TOML for everything except secrets; secrets in a separate AES-GCM encrypted file. Rationale: (1) 29MB budget — every engine adds resident memory + threads; (2) no query/concurrency needs; (3) human-editable + diffable backups (the original app's DB was opaque); (4) fewer moving parts = fewer failure modes on a desktop tool.

But I should be honest about the tradeoff: TOML rewrites the whole file on save (write-behind debounce + atomic rename), no partial updates, no concurrent access, and if the file grows to tens of MB it gets slow. For a connection manager that's fine.

Also offer the DB options matrix with measured/verified facts:

Now the 口令模型 explanation (说人话):
Definition: "口令模型" = 三个问题的答案：
1. 口令保护什么（整库文件 or 只保护凭据字段）
2. 密钥从哪来（用户输入派生 or Windows 账户绑定）
3. 启动要不要问你要口令 / 忘了怎么办

Options matrix:
A. 沿用原版：整库一个口令，启动弹框输入。
 - 优点：和老版本一致；无口令不能打开任何数据。
 - 缺点：每次启动都要输；原版用 MD5(GB2312) 派生，弱；换机器/忘记口令 = 数据不可恢复。
B. Windows 数据保护 API（DPAPI, CryptProtectData）+ 可选 entropy：完全无感，不弹框。
 - 优点：零 UX 成本；密钥由系统管理，不用记口令；同一 Windows 账户下自动可解；实现最简单。
 - 缺点：威胁模型只是「防别人翻你文件/防明文泄露」，挡不住以你身份运行的进程；账户密码重置(EFS/DPAPI master key 丢失)会导致密文不可解（域环境有备份，本机一般没问题）。
C. 主口令包裹数据密钥（DEK/KEK 两层）：Argon2id 派生 KEK → 加密随机 DEK → DEK 加密凭据。
 - 优点：真正的「口令即安全边界」；可换口令（只重包 DEK，不用重新加密所有数据）；能验证口令对错（原版 LiteDB 那个坑就是没法验证）。
 - 缺点：每次启动要输；忘了就全丢。
D. 混合（推荐）：默认 B（无感），设置里可选开启 C（"给凭据加主口令"），开启后启动提示输入；两者共用同一套 DEK 加密字段，切换只重包 DEK。
 - 优点：普通用户零成本，进阶用户有真边界；可逆（关掉就退回 DPAPI 包裹）。
 - 缺点：两条密钥路径要测；设置页多一个开关。

Recommendation: D, with concrete library choices: `keyring 4.2`（Windows 凭据管理器）vs 直接 DPAPI via `windows-sys`. Hmm — which? DPAPI CryptProtectData is simplest and needs no extra service; keyring abstracts cross-platform (we're Windows-only → DPAPI direct is fewer deps). But keyring's Windows backend uses Credential Manager (also DPAPI-ish under hood? no, it's a separate secure store with per-credential storage, 2564-byte limit per credential → private keys can exceed that). So for private keys (can be 10s of KB), DPAPI blob in our own file is better than Credential Manager (size limits). Good concrete point: Credential Manager 单条上限 ~1.3KB(老)/2564 bytes → 不适合存私钥。So: DPAPI + our own secrets file, not keyring.

Also: 原版那个 LiteDB 口令校验坑（memory）— 我在方案里可以顺带解决：C/D 的 KEK 校验（用 AEAD tag 验证 DEK 解包成功 = 口令正确），比原版"构造函数不校验"干净。

Also mention: 忘记口令的可恢复性选项 — 生成一次性恢复码（打印/保存）。That's a product decision; mention as optional.

Also for TOML: 结构建议（sections），write-behind 原子保存（temp+rename），以及为什么把 secrets 分文件（避免明文配置和密文混在一起、便于单独备份/删除、TOML 里不出现任何凭据）。

Also: 阶段二交付边界（what I'd build): 
- `sr-store` crate: models ↔ TOML, atomic save with debounce, migration/version field
- `sr-secret`: AES-256-GCM + DPAPI/Argon2 KEK, 口令修改、错误口令检测
- 设置页 UI：数据目录、改密、重置
- 单测：round-trip、损坏文件、口令错误

## 1. 「口令模型」是什么意思

就是三个问题的答案：**口令保护哪一层**（整库文件 vs 只保护凭据字段）、**密钥从哪来**（你输入的口令派生 vs Windows 账户绑定）、**启动要不要问你要口令，忘了怎么办**。原版是「整个 `RemoteItems.db` 一个口令、启动弹框、`MD5(GB2312)` 派生」——派生弱，而且 LiteDB 的 `Database` 构造函数不校验错误口令（这个坑我记在项目记忆里），所以「口令错了」这件事它自己都检测不出来。

| 方案 | 启动体验 | 真实防护力 | 忘口令后果 | 可逆性 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A 沿用原版：整库一个口令 | 每次弹框 | 中（但原版 KDF 弱） | 数据全丢 | — |
| B DPAPI 绑定 Windows 账户（`CryptProtectData`） | 无感，不弹框 | 只防「别人拷走文件」，挡不住以你身份跑的进程 | 无此问题 | 高 |
| C 主口令包数据密钥（Argon2id→KEK→随机 DEK） | 每次弹框 | 真正的安全边界；换口令只重包 DEK，不用重加密全部数据；AEAD 标签天然能校验口令对错 | 数据全丢（可加恢复码） | 中 |
| **D 混合：默认 B，设置里可开 C**（推荐） | 默认无感；开了才弹框 | 按需 | 按需 | 高，两档共用同一套字段加密，切换只重包 DEK |

**推荐 D**，并且**不要用 `keyring`/Windows 凭据管理器存私钥**——它单条有约 2.5KB 上限，SSH 私钥很容易超；DPAPI 加密后写我们自己的文件没有这个限制。

## 2. 本地存储：我的建议是**不引入数据库引擎**

你的数据形态是「一棵几百到几千节点的树 + 每条连接一份设置 + 少量凭据」，单进程、无并发、无查询需求。这种负载下引擎是纯负担——尤其是我们刚把空载压到 29MB。

| 选项 | 现状（已核实） | 对本项目的代价 | 加密 | 结论 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **无引擎：`config.toml` + 密文 `secrets.bin`** | 0 新增运行时依赖 | 0 线程、0 常驻；全量原子重写（temp+rename） | 自己做字段级 AES-GCM（`aes-gcm 0.11.1`） | **推荐** |
| redb | 4.4.0，纯 Rust，MIT/Apache，需 rustc ≥1.90（本机 1.99 ✓） | 单文件、mmap、无后台线程，最轻的「真 DB」 | **无**（源码里搜不到 encrypt，4.4 没有加密能力） | 日后需要事务/索引时的首选升级位 |
| rusqlite + `bundled-sqlcipher` | 0.41.0，特性已确认存在 | C 依赖，exe 体积 +1.5~2MB，构建变慢 | 整库 AES-256 | 最成熟但过度装备 |
| heed (LMDB) | 0.23.0 | mmap 只增不还，与内存目标冲突 | 无 | 不适合 |
| rocksdb | 0.25.0 | 后台线程 + 写缓冲，常驻最高 | 无 | 与目标相反 |
| sled | **仍停在 1.0.0-alpha.124** | — | 无 | 不要用 |
| surrealdb | 3.3.4 | 服务器级 | — | 不适用 |

配套的落盘布局（这也回答了你「TOML 存什么」）：

- `config.toml`：目录树、连接元数据（名称/类型/主机/端口/用户名）、各协议设置、窗口习惯。**里面永远不出现任何凭据**，所以可以随手丢进网盘/ git 备份、可以手改。
- `secrets.bin`：`{凭据id → AES-256-GCM(nonce, 密文, tag)}`，密钥走上面 D 方案。凭据 id 与 TOML 里的连接 id 关联。
- 写入用「防抖 + 原子替换」（原版是每次属性变更立刻落库，Iced 下会变成每次击键重写整个 TOML，所以必须防抖——这条我会照原版 200ms 搜索防抖的同样思路做）。

## 3. 定了我就开工

需要你点头的就两句：**口令模型选 D 还是纯 B**（纯 B 更简单，但没人能给你「口令保护」这件事）；**存储选「无引擎 TOML+密文文件」还是直接上 redb**。

Now the design of sr-store:

```
crates/sr-store/src/
├─ lib.rs        — pub mod {document, keys, paths, secrets, error}; re-exports
├─ error.rs      — StoreError (thiserror)
├─ paths.rs      — DataPaths: 数据目录解析与创建（%APPDATA%\SimpleRemote 优先，可配置）
├─ document.rs   — StoreDoc（版本、目录树、连接、设置）↔ TOML；原子保存；加载

└─ secrets.rs    — secrets.bin 文件：AES-256-GCM 记录表 {id → blob}

Data model in TOML. Design for hand-editability + versioning:

```toml
# SimpleRemote 配置文件
schema = 1

[app]
last_window_width = 1180
...

[[directory]]  # or tree structure
```
Nested tree in TOML: use `[[node]]` array with `children` nested? TOML supports nested arrays of tables. A recursive struct with `Vec<Node>` serializes fine with `toml` crate.

```rust
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct StoreDoc {
    pub schema: u32,
    pub tree: Vec<Node>,          // 根层节点
    #[serde(default)]
    pub expanded: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub habits: Habits,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(untagged)]  // hmm, needs a discriminator
pub enum Node { ... }
```
For TOML, an untagged enum with `directory`/`session` keys works but is fragile for hand-editing. Better: a single struct with optional fields and a `type` tag:

```toml
[[node]]
id = "a1b2..."
type = "dir"
name = "生产环境"
children = ["id1", "id2"]     # 子节点 id
[[node]]
id = "id1"
type = "ssh"
name = "Web-01"
host = "10.20.1.11"
port = 22
username = "ops"
parent = "a1b2..."
```
Flat list + parent/children ids = easy hand-edit, but tree reconstruction and reordering get fiddly, and `children` order matters.

Alternative: nested inline tables:
```toml
[[tree]]
name = "生产环境"
type = "dir"
id = "..."
  [[tree.children]]
  id = "..."
  type = "ssh"
  name = "Web-01"
  host = "..."
```
The `toml` crate handles recursive structs: `struct Node { id, name, #[serde(default)] children: Vec<Node> }`. Serde supports recursive types via Vec (heap) ✓.

Discriminating dir vs session: use `#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all="lowercase")] enum Node { Dir{...}, Session{...} }`. Internally-tagged enums work with TOML for structs (not newtype variants). Let me use:
```rust
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum NodeDoc {
    Dir { id: String, name: String, #[serde(default)] children: Vec<NodeDoc> },
    Session { id: String, name: String, #[serde(rename = "type")] kind: SessionKindDoc, host: String, port: u16, #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if="Option::is_none")] username: Option<String> },
}
```
Hmm, `kind` tag collides with session's `type` field. Let me name the tag `node = "dir"|"session"` and the protocol field `protocol = "ssh"|"rdp"|"telnet"`. Cleaner for hand-editing:

```toml
[[tree]]
node = "dir"
id = "prod"
name = "生产环境"
  [[tree.children]]
  node = "session"
  id = "prod-web-01"
  name = "Web-01"
  protocol = "ssh"
  host = "10.20.1.11"
  port = 22
  username = "ops"
```
✓ readable.

But sr-core's domain types (`SessionTree`, `SessionNode`) are what the app uses. So sr-store should convert between docs and domain. Where to put the conversion? Options:
(a) sr-store defines doc structs + `to_domain()`/`from_domain()` — needs a dependency on sr-core. Fine: sr-store depends on sr-core (domain), sr-app depends on both.
(b) Put serde derives directly on sr-core types — but then sr-core gains serde dep; that's actually common and fine. Hmm, sr-core is "no UI" not "no deps". Adding serde to sr-core is acceptable... but I prefer keeping domain types clean and having explicit doc types (schema evolution ≠ domain evolution, e.g. `schema` versioning, migrations).

Decision: (a) sr-store depends on sr-core, defines `document.rs` with doc types + conversions.

Secrets file design (`secrets.bin`):
- Not TOML (binary blobs). Format: a small binary container:
  header: magic "SRSC1" | wrapped DEK info | records
  Actually simpler and more debuggable: keep the *crypto envelope* in a TOML file too, with base64/hex strings? Hex/base64 in TOML is hand-editable-ish but noisy.

Let me design:
`keys.toml` (or inside config.toml under [security]):
```toml
[security]
mode = "os"            # "os" = DPAPI 包裹, "password" = 主口令包裹
salt = "<hex>"         # 仅 password 模式
iterations = 2          # argon2 t_cost (记录参数以便兼容)
memory_kib = 19456
wrapped_dek = "<hex>"  # AES-GCM(KEK, DEK)，nonce 前缀
```
`secrets.bin`:
```
"SRSC" | u8 version | u32 record_count? 
records: [len:u16][id][nonce:12][ct+tag]
```
Simpler: a TOML file `secrets.toml` with `id = "<hex(nonce||ct||tag)>"`. Human-readable keys, no custom parser, and the file is opaque anyway. Size: passwords/keys — private keys can be a few KB → hex doubles it. Fine for a desktop tool.

I like `secrets.toml` for uniformity (one format, easy atomic write, no binary parsing bugs). Let me do that. Hmm, but "私钥" could be 3-8KB → hex 16KB per entry. Acceptable.

Actually — should private keys be stored as secret blobs? The original stored the private key *text* in the DB. Yes, store the PEM text encrypted.

So:
- `config.toml`: schema, tree, expanded, habits (window size, last data dir?), security params (mode/salt/wrapped_dek).
- `secrets.toml`: `{ id = "hex(nonce|ciphertext|tag)" }` — encrypted with DEK (AES-256-GCM), AAD = the id string (binds record to key, prevents swapping) ✓ nice touch.

Key management (keys.rs):
```rust
pub enum KeyMode { Os, MasterPassword }
pub struct DataKey(Zeroizing<[u8;32]>);
pub struct SecurityConfig { mode, salt: Option<Vec<u8>>, wrapped_dek: Vec<u8> }  // stored in config.toml
```
- `SecurityConfig::new_random(mode)` → generate DEK, wrap with DPAPI (mode=Os) or with KEK from password.
- `unlock(&self, password: Option<&str>) -> Result<DataKey>` → unwrap. Wrong password → AEAD tag failure → `Error::WrongPassword` ✓ (solves the original LiteDB can't-verify problem).
- `set_master_password(&mut, current, new)` → unwrap DEK, re-wrap with new KEK (only DEK re-wrapped, secrets untouched) ✓
- `remove_master_password` → re-wrap with DPAPI.

DPAPI on non-Windows: cfg(windows) only; for tests on other platforms... we're Windows-only, so gate with `#[cfg(windows)]` and return an error otherwise. Since the project is Windows-only, fine. But my unit tests must run on Windows ✓ they do.

Nonce: 12 random bytes per record via getrandom ✓. Never reuse nonce with same DEK — random 96-bit nonces with a few thousand records → collision probability negligible (birthday bound ~2^48 records). Acceptable; note it.

Field edits: save when the input loses focus? iced text_input has `on_submit` (Enter). Design:
- Edits to session fields update the in-memory domain immediately (so the tree label updates) and mark `dirty`.
- Autosave trigger: a periodic `iced::time::every(Duration::from_millis(1500))` subscription that, if dirty, saves. That's simple, uses the tokio executor, and is effectively write-behind debouncing.
- Also save on app exit (iced `keyboard::events`? window close event) — iced has `window::close_events`. For Phase 2, the periodic save covers it (≤1.5s loss window).

Let me use the subscription approach: `Message::AutosaveTick`. `App::subscription()` returns `iced::time::every(1.5s).map(|_| Message::AutosaveTick)`. That costs a wakeup every 1.5s — negligible? It does keep the process awake; for a memory-focused app, a 1.5s timer is fine (it only fires when dirty... no, the subscription always fires). Alternative: only subscribe when dirty: `if app.dirty { time::every(...) } else { Subscription::none() }` ✓ — the subscription function takes &State, so this works elegantly.

//! 数据目录与文件名。默认 %APPDATA%\SimpleRemote，可用 SR_DATA_DIR 覆盖（便于测试与便携）。

use std::path::PathBuf;

pub const CONFIG_FILE: &str = "config.toml";
pub const SECRETS_FILE: &str = "secrets.toml";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct DataPaths {
    pub dir: PathBuf,
}

impl DataPaths {
    pub fn resolve() -> Self { from_dir(default_root()) }
    pub fn from_dir(dir: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self
    pub fn config(&self) -> PathBuf
    pub fn secrets(&self) -> PathBuf
    pub fn ensure_dir(&self) -> Result<(), StoreError>
    pub fn exists(&self) -> bool  // config file exists
}

fn default_root() -> PathBuf {
    if let Ok(dir) = std::env::var("SR_DATA_DIR") { if !dir.trim().is_empty() { return PathBuf::from(dir) } }
    let appdata = std::env::var("APPDATA")...  // %APPDATA%\SimpleRemote
    fallback: dirs? no deps. Use APPDATA env; if missing, use current_dir.
}
```

```rust
fn write_atomic(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), StoreError> {
    let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
    fs::write(&tmp, bytes)?;
    fs::rename(tmp, path)?;   // Windows: rename over existing works if target not open; ReplaceFileW not needed
}
```
On Windows, `std::fs::rename` fails if the target exists?? No — on Windows, `MoveFileEx` without REPLACE_EXISTING fails when the target exists; but Rust's `fs::rename` on Windows uses `MoveFileExW` **with** MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING, so overwriting works ✓. Good, but if the target file is open by another process (e.g., Notepad), it fails — acceptable, surface the error.

  "content": "//! 十六进制编解码。只为配置文件里的密文可读可手改，不值得为此多引一个依赖。\n\npub fn encode(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {\n    const DIGITS: &[u8; 16] = b\"0123456789abcdef\";\n    let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);\n    for byte in bytes {\n        out.push(DIGITS[(byte >> 4) as usize] as char);\n        out.push(DIGITS[(byte & 0x0f) as usize] as char);\n    }\n    out\n}\n\npub fn decode(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {\n    if text.len() % 2 != 0 {\n        return Err(format!(\"长度不是偶数：{}\", text.len()));\n    }\n\n    let bytes = text.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len() / 2);\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        let hi = digit(bytes[i])?;\n        let lo = digit(bytes[i + 1])?;\n        out.push(hi << 4 | lo);\n        i += 2;\n    }\n    Ok(out)\n}\n\nfn digit(byte: u8) -> Result<u8, String> {\n    match byte {\n        b'0'..=b'9' => Ok(byte - b'0'),\n        b'a'..=b'f' => Ok(byte - b'a' + 10),\n        b'A'..=b'F' => Ok(byte - b'A' + 10),\n        _ => Err(format!(\"非法字符：{:?}\", byte as char)),\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn round_trip_and_uppercase_input() {\n        let bytes = [0x00, 0x0f, 0xf0, 0xff, 0x7a];\n        let text = encode(&bytes);\n        assert_eq!(text, \"000ff0ff7a\");\n        assert_eq!(decode(&text).unwrap(), bytes);\n        assert_eq!(decode(\"000FF0FF7A\").unwrap(), bytes);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rejects_malformed_input() {\n        assert!(decode(\"0\").is_err());\n        assert!(decode(\"zz\").is_err());\n        assert_eq!(decode(\"\").unwrap(), Vec::<u8>::new());\n    }\n}\n",

```rust
//! 数据密钥（DEK）与两种包裹方式：Windows DPAPI（默认，无感）与主口令（Argon2id 派生 KEK）。
//!
//! 换口令只重包 DEK，凭据密文不动 —— 这是选 DEK/KEK 两层结构的原因。

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use zeroize::Zeroizing;

use crate::error::StoreError;
use crate::hex;

pub const DEK_LEN: usize = 32;
pub const NONCE_LEN: usize = 12;
pub const SALT_LEN: usize = 16;

/// AAD：把「包裹密钥」这一用途绑进密文，避免 DEK 密文被挪去当凭据密文用。
const DEK_AAD: &[u8] = b"SimpleRemote-dek-v1";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum KeyMode {
    /// 密钥绑定当前 Windows 用户，启动不问口令。
    Os,
    /// 口令参与密钥派生，启动必须输入口令。
    Password,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]

#[cfg(windows)]
mod dpapi {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::LocalFree;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::Cryptography::{
        CryptProtectData, CryptUnprotectData, CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB, CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN,
    };

    pub fn protect(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
        let in_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB { cbData: data.len() as u32, pbData: data.as_ptr() as *mut u8 };
        let mut out = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB::default();
        let ok = unsafe {
            CryptProtectData(&in_blob, std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null_mut(), std::ptr::null(), CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN, &mut out)
        };
        if ok != 0 { copy out and LocalFree } else { Err(format!(GetLastError)) }
    }
}

pub struct Payload<'msg, 'aad> {
    /// Message to be encrypted/decrypted
    pub msg: &'msg [u8],

    /// Optional "additional associated data" to authenticate along with
    /// this message. If AAD is provided at the time the message is encrypted,
    /// the same AAD *MUST* be provided at the time the message is decrypted,
    /// or decryption will fail.
    pub aad: &'aad [u8],
}

impl<'msg> From<&'msg [u8]> for Payload<'msg, '_> {
    fn from(msg: &'msg [u8]) -> Self {
        Self { msg, aad: b"" }

`[security]` 段。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Security {\n    pub mode: KeyMode,\n    /// Argon2id 的 salt（hex），仅 `Password` 模式需要。\n    #[serde(default, Ok(Self(Zeroizing::new(bytes)))\n    }\n\n    pub fn generate() -> Result<Self, StoreError> {\n        Ok(Self(Zeroizing::new(random_bytes(DEK_LEN)?)))\n    }\n\n    pub fn bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {\n security = Security {\n        mode,\n        salt: None,\n        wrapped_dek: String::new(),\n    };\n    rewrap(&mut security, &dek, mode, password)?;\n    Ok((security, dek))\n}\n\n/// 解开 hex::decode(&security.wrapped_dek).map_err(StoreError::Secret)?;\n\n    match security.mode {\n        KeyMode::Os => DataKey::from_bytes(dpapi::unprotect(&blob)?),\n        KeyMode::Password => {\n Security,\n    dek: &DataKey,\n    mode: KeyMode,\n    password: Option<&str>,\n) -> Result<(), StoreError> {\n    match mode {\n        KeyMode::Os => {\n            security.mode = mode;\n pub use error::StoreError;

    NeedsPassword,
    WrongPassword,
    Failed(StoreError),
}

/// 打开时做过的一次性补救，交给 UI 提示用户。
pub enum Notice {
    ConfigRestored { backup: PathBuf, reason: String },
    SecretsRestored { backup: PathBuf, reason: String },
}

pub struct Opened { pub store: Store, pub notices: Vec<Notice> }

pub struct Store {
    paths: DataPaths,
    doc: ConfigDoc,
    tree: SessionTree,
    secrets: SecretStore,
    key: DataKey,
    config_dirty: bool,
    id_prefix: String,
    id_seq: AtomicU64,
}

open():
1. ensure_dir
2. read config.toml:
   - NotFound → create fresh: `create(KeyMode::Os, None)` → security + key; doc = ConfigDoc::empty(Some(security)); tree empty; config_dirty = true (so first save writes it). Actually write immediately on creation so the file exists (helps users find it). Let me save() right away.
   - Ok(text) → parse; on Decode error → back up + fresh; on UnsupportedSchema → Failed (don't clobber a newer file!). Important: don't back-up-and-replace for UnsupportedSchema; that would destroy data. Return Failed.
3. security: if doc.security is None → create Os-mode security + key, mark config dirty.
4. unlock key with password → NeedsPassword / WrongPassword.
5. tree = doc.to_tree()
6. secrets = SecretStore::load(paths.secrets(), &key) → on Decode error, back up + empty (Notice::SecretsRestored).

save():
- doc = doc.with_tree(&tree) (sync tree → doc) — do it in save to avoid double bookkeeping. But `security` lives in doc; `with_tree` preserves it ✓.
- write_atomic(config) if config_dirty || doc differs... simplest: always write config on save() (cheap: a few KB). But writing on every tick when nothing changed causes disk churn and could break the "only save when dirty" debounce. Let me keep `config_dirty` flag; the app sets it via `mark_dirty()`.
- secrets.save() if dirty.

Also: `tree()` / `tree_mut()` — tree_mut should mark config dirty automatically (any structural edit goes through it) ✓ that's less error-prone than asking callers to remember. Field edits also go through tree_mut → dirty ✓. Password edits go through `set_password` → secrets dirty ✓.

pub fn open(paths: DataPaths, password: Option<&str>) -> Result<Opened, OpenError> {
    let mut notices = Vec::new();
    paths.ensure_dir()?;

    let mut doc = match Self::read_config(&paths)? {
        Some(text) => match ConfigDoc::parse(&text) {
            Ok(doc) => doc,
            Err(err @ StoreError::UnsupportedSchema(_)) => return Err(err.into()),
            Err(other) => {
                let backup = move_aside(&paths.config(), "config")?;
                notices.push(Notice::ConfigRestored { backup, reason: other.to_string() });
                ConfigDoc::empty(None)
            }
        },
        None => ConfigDoc::empty(None),
    };

    let created = doc.security.is_none();
    if created {
        let (security, key) = create(KeyMode::Os, None)?;
        doc.security = Some(security);
        let store = Self::assemble(doc, key, paths, &mut notices)?;
        let mut store = store;
        store.save()?;   // 首次落盘，让文件立刻存在
        return Ok(Opened { store, notices });
    }

    let security = doc.security.clone().expect("checked above");
    let key = match unlock(&security, password) { ... };
    let store = Self::assemble(doc, key, paths, &mut notices)?;
    Ok(Opened { store, notices })
}

fn assemble(doc, key, paths, notices) -> Result<Store, OpenError> {
    let secrets = match SecretStore::load(paths.secrets(), &key) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(err) if err.is_corruption() => {
            let backup = move_aside(&paths.secrets(), "secrets")?;
            notices.push(Notice::SecretsRestored { backup, reason: err.to_string() });
            SecretStore::load(paths.secrets(), &key)?
        }
        Err(err) => return Err(err.into()),
    };
    let tree = doc.to_tree();
    Ok(Store { id_prefix: ..., id_seq: ..., config_dirty: false, paths, doc, tree, secrets, key })
}

//! Listen and react to time.
pub use crate::core::time::*;

#[allow(unused_imports)]
#[cfg_attr(
    docsrs,
    doc(cfg(any(
        feature = "tokio",
        feature = "smol",
        target_arch = "wasm32"

pub use iced_futures::backend::default::time::*;

use crate::Task;

/// Returns a [`Task`] that produces the current [`Instant`]
/// by calling [`Instant::now`].
///
/// While you can call [`Instant::now`] directly in your application;
/// that renders your application "impure" (i.e. no referential transparency).
///
/// You may care about purity if you want to leverage the `time-travel`
/// feature properly.
pub fn now() -> Task<Instant> {
    Task::future(async { Instant::now() })
}

#### Thinking

The test caught a real leak: `remove_node` only forgets the removed node's own id from `expanded`, so a deleted directory's **descendant** ids stay in the expanded set forever. Since `expanded` is persisted to `config.toml`, deleting a directory would leave orphan entries accumulating in the file.

Fix: when removing, purge all directory ids in the removed subtree from `expanded`.

```rust
let removed = walk(&mut self.roots, id);
if let Some(node) = &removed {
    self.expanded.remove(id);
    for dir_id in subtree_directory_ids(node) { self.expanded.remove(&dir_id); }
}
```

Actually simpler: make `subtree_session_ids` generic-ish? No, add a small private helper.

let removed = walk(&mut self.roots, id);
if let Some(node) = &removed {
    let mut stale = vec![node.id().clone()];
    collect_dir_ids(node, &mut stale);
    for key in stale { self.expanded.remove(&key); }
}
```
where collect_dir_ids pushes all directory ids in the subtree (excluding the root, already added).

Wait — `collect_directory_ids` pushes child ids unconditionally (including session children ids). That's wrong: it pushes `child.id()` for every child, then recurses only for directories. So session ids get pushed too — harmless for `expanded.remove()` (they're not in expanded), but semantically sloppy. Let me fix: only push directory ids.

```rust
fn collect_directory_ids(node: &SessionNode, out: &mut Vec<SessionId>) {
    if let SessionNode::Directory(dir) = node {
        for child in &dir.children {
            if let SessionNode::Directory(sub) = child {
                out.push(sub.id.clone());
                collect_directory_ids(child, out);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

//! 应用状态与消息路由。

use std::time::Duration;
use iced::widget::row;
use iced::{Element, Fill, Subscription, Task, Theme};
use sr_core::session::{Session, SessionKind, SessionTree, TreeRow};
use sr_core::tab::{Tab, TabManager};
use sr_store::{DataPaths, KeyMode, OpenError, Store};

use crate::{theme, ui};

pub struct App {
    pub(crate) screen: Screen,
    pub(crate) paths: DataPaths,
    pub(crate) store: Option<Store>,
    pub(crate) search: String,
    pub(crate) rows: Vec<TreeRow>,
    pub(crate) tabs: TabManager,
    pub(crate) show_home: bool,
    pub(crate) selected: Option<String>,
    pub(crate) draft: Draft,
    pub(crate) status: Option<Status>,
    pub(crate) unlock: UnlockForm,
    pub(crate) master_password_draft: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Screen { Remote, Settings, Unlock, Fatal(String) }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Status { pub message: String, pub level: StatusLevel }
pub enum StatusLevel { Info, Error }

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]

    pub name: String,
    pub host: String,
    pub port: String,
    pub username: String,
    pub password: String,
    pub reveal_password: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct UnlockForm { pub password: String, pub error: Option<String> }

App::new:
```rust
pub fn new() -> Self {
    let paths = DataPaths::resolve();
    let mut app = Self {
        screen: Screen::Remote, paths: paths.clone(), store: None, search: String::new(),
        rows: Vec::new(), tabs: TabManager::default(), show_home: true, selected: None,
        draft: Draft::default(), status: None, unlock: UnlockForm::default(),
        master_password_draft: String::new(),
    };

    match Store::open(paths, None) {
        Ok(opened) => app.adopt_store(opened),
        Err(OpenError::NeedsPassword) => { app.screen = Screen::Unlock; }
        Err(other) => { app.screen = Screen::Fatal(other.to_string()); }
    }
    app.sync_rows();
    app
}

fn adopt_store(&mut self, opened: Opened) {
    let Opened { store, notices } = opened;
    self.store = Some(store);
    self.screen = Screen::Remote;
    if let Some(notice) = notices.first() { self.status = Some(Status::from(notice)); }
    self.sync_rows();
}
```

    }
}

}

  scrollable(\n            column![\n                text(\"设置\").size(16),\n                ui::status_bar(app.status.as_ref()),\n                data_dir_card(app),\n data_dir_card(app: &App) -> Element<'_, Message> {\n    let path = app.paths.dir().display().to_string();\n\n    card(\n        \"数据目录\",\n        \"配置与会话保存在这个目录；改目录请设环境变量 SR_DATA_DIR 后重启程序。\",\n ui::ghost_button(\"打开目录\", Message::RevealDataDir),\n        ]\n        .spacing(10)\n        .align_y(alignment::Vertical::Center),\n    )\n}\n\nfn security_card(app: &App) -> Element<'_, Message> {\n    let protected = app.key_mode() == KeyMode::Password;\n\n    let mode_line = row![\n        container(text(if protected { \"主口令\" } else { \"系统密钥库\" })\n            .size(11)\n            .color(if protected { theme::ACCENT } else { theme::TEXT_DIM }))\n        .padding([3.0, 9.0])\n        .style(theme::status_pill),\n        space_fill(),\n    ]\n    .spacing(10);\n\n    let .spacing(10);\n\n    card(\"凭据加密\", explanation, column![mode_line, form].spacing(10).width(Fill))\n}\n\nfn card<'a>(title: &str, hint: &str, body: impl Into<Element<'a, Message>>) -> Element<'a, public int Top; public int Right; public int Bottom; }\npublic delegate bool SR_WNDENUMPROC(IntPtr hWnd, IntPtr lParam);\npublic class SRWin32 {\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(IntPtr ctx);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool EnumWindows(SR_WNDENUMPROC cb, IntPtr l);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr hWnd, out uint pid);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr hWnd, out SR_RECT rect);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern uint GetDpiForWindow(IntPtr hWnd);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool SetWindowPos(IntPtr h, IntPtr after, int x, int y, int cx, int cy, uint f);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool SetCursorPos(int x, int y);\n    [DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern void mouse_event(uint flags, uint data, uint extra, IntPtr reserved);\n}\n\"@\n# 探针必须是 DPI 感知的，否则 GetWindowRect（虚拟化坐标）与 CopyFromScreen（物理像素）不在同一坐标系\n[void][SRWin32]::SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext([IntPtr](-4))\n\n$HWND_TOPMOST = [IntPtr](-1)\n$SWP_NOSIZE = 0x1; $SWP_NOMOVE = 0x2; $SWP_NOACTIVATE = 0x10; $SWP_SHOWWINDOW = 0x40\n$DOWN = 0x2; $UP = 0x4\n\n$script:found = @()\n$cb = [SR_WNDENUMPROC] {\n    param($hWnd, $lParam)\n    $p = 0\n    [void][SRWin32]::GetWindowThreadProcessId($hWnd, [ref]$p)\n    if ($p -eq $script:pid) {\n        $r = New-Object SR_RECT\n        [void][SRWin32]::GetWindowRect($hWnd, [ref]$r)\n        $script:found += [pscustomobject]@{ HWnd = $hWnd; Area = ($r.Right - $r.Left) * ($r.Bottom - $r.Top) }\n    }\n    return $true\n}\n\n$mainHwnd = [IntPtr]::Zero\n$originX = 0; $originY = 0; $scale = 1.0\n\nfunction Update-Origin {\n    $script:found = @()\n    [void][SRWin32]::EnumWindows($cb, [IntPtr]::Zero)\n    $best = $script:found | Sort-Object Area -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n    if ($null -eq $best) { throw \"找不到 $script:name 的窗口\" }\n    $script:mainHwnd = $best.HWnd\n    $r = New-Object SR_RECT\n    [void][SRWin32]::GetWindowRect($script:mainHwnd, [ref]$r)\n    $script:originX = $r.Left; $script:originY = $r.Top\n    $script:scale = [SRWin32]::GetDpiForWindow($script:mainHwnd) / 96.0\n}\n\nfunction Shot([string]$name) {\n    $r = New-Object SR_RECT\n    [void][SRWin32]::GetWindowRect($script:mainHwnd, [ref]$r)\n    $w = $r.Right - $r.Left; $h = $r.Bottom - $r.Top\n    $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($w, $h)\n    $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)\n    $g.CopyFromScreen($r.Left, $r.Top, 0, 0, (New-Object System.Drawing.Size($w, $h)))\n    $g.Dispose()\n    $path = Join-Path $OutDir \"$name.png\"\n    $bmp.Save($path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)\n    $bmp.Dispose()\n    Write-Output \"shot=$path ${w}x${h}\"\n}\n\nfunction Click([double]$lx, [double]$ly) {\n    $sx = $script:originX + [int]($lx * $script:scale)\n    $sy = $script:originY + [int]($ly * $script:scale)\n    [void][SRWin32]::SetCursorPos($sx, $sy)\n    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 180\n    [SRWin32]::mouse_event($DOWN, 0, 0, [IntPtr]::Zero)\n    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 60\n    [SRWin32]::mouse_event($UP, 0, 0, [IntPtr]::Zero)\n    Write-Output \"click logical=($lx,$ly)\"\n    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 450\n}\n\n# 用剪贴板粘贴输入：这台机器开着中文输入法，SendKeys 打字母会进组合态而不提交给应用\nfunction Type([string]$text) {\n    Set-Clipboard -Value $text\n    [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait(\"^a\")\n    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150\n    [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait(\"^v\")\n    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 350\n    Write-Output \"typed=$text\"\n}\n\nfunction Mem([string]$label) {\n    $proc.Refresh()\n    Write-Output (\"{0} working_set_mb={1} private_mb={2}\" -f $label, [math]::Round($proc.WorkingSet64 / 1MB, 1), [math]::Round($proc.PrivateMemorySize64 / 1MB, 1))\n}\n\n$env:$EnvName = $DataDir\n$proc = Start-Process -FilePath $ExePath -PassThru\n$script:pid = [uint32]$proc.Id\n$script:name = Split-Path $ExePath -Leaf\n\n$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(15)\nwhile ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {\n    try { Update-Origin; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400 }\n}\n[void][SRWin32]::SetWindowPos($mainHwnd, $HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, ($SWP_NOMOVE -bor $SWP_NOSIZE -bor $SWP_NOACTIVATE -bor $SWP_SHOWWINDOW))\nStart-Sleep -Seconds 6\nUpdate-Origin\nWrite-Output \"scale=$scale origin=$originX,$originY\"\nMem \"idle\"\n\nforeach ($action in $Actions.Split(';')) {\n    $a = $action.Trim()\n    if ($a.Length -eq 0) { continue }\n    $parts = $a.Split(':', 2)\n    $verb = $parts[0]; $arg = if ($parts.Count -gt 1) { $parts[1] } else { '' }\n    switch ($verb) {\n        'shot'   { Shot $arg }\n        'wait'   { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds ([int]$arg) }\n        'click'  { $xy = $arg.Split(','); Click ([double]$xy[0]) ([double]$xy[1]) }\n        'type'   { Type $arg }\n        'keys'   { [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait($arg); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300; Write-Output \"keys=$arg\" }\n        'mem'    { Mem $arg }\n        default  { Write-Output \"unknown action: $a\" }\n    }\n}\n\nMem \"final\"\nStop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force\nWrite-Output \"RESULT=OK datadir=$DataDir\"\n",

}

  "content": "//! 十六进制编解码。只为配置文件里的密文可读可手改，不值得为此多引一个依赖。\n\npub fn encode(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {\n    const DIGITS: &[u8; 16] = b\"0123456789abcdef\";\n    let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);\n    for byte in bytes {\n        out.push(DIGITS[(byte >> 4) as usize] as char);\n        out.push(DIGITS[(byte & 0x0f) as usize] as char);\n    }\n    out\n}\n\npub fn decode(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {\n    if text.len() % 2 != 0 {\n        return Err(format!(\"长度不是偶数：{}\", text.len()));\n    }\n\n    let bytes = text.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len() / 2);\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        let hi = digit(bytes[i])?;\n        let lo = digit(bytes[i + 1])?;\n        out.push(hi << 4 | lo);\n        i += 2;\n    }\n    Ok(out)\n}\n\nfn digit(byte: u8) -> Result<u8, String> {\n    match byte {\n        b'0'..=b'9' => Ok(byte - b'0'),\n        b'a'..=b'f' => Ok(byte - b'a' + 10),\n        b'A'..=b'F' => Ok(byte - b'A' + 10),\n        _ => Err(format!(\"非法字符：{:?}\", byte as char)),\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn round_trip_and_uppercase_input() {\n        let bytes = [0x00, 0x0f, 0xf0, 0xff, 0x7a];\n        let text = encode(&bytes);\n        assert_eq!(text, \"000ff0ff7a\");\n        assert_eq!(decode(&text).unwrap(), bytes);\n        assert_eq!(decode(\"000FF0FF7A\").unwrap(), bytes);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rejects_malformed_input() {\n        assert!(decode(\"0\").is_err());\n        assert!(decode(\"zz\").is_err());\n        assert_eq!(decode(\"\").unwrap(), Vec::<u8>::new());\n    }\n}\n",

pub struct Payload<'msg, 'aad> {
    /// Message to be encrypted/decrypted
    pub msg: &'msg [u8],

    /// Optional "additional associated data" to authenticate along with
    /// this message. If AAD is provided at the time the message is encrypted,
    /// the same AAD *MUST* be provided at the time the message is decrypted,
    /// or decryption will fail.
    pub aad: &'aad [u8],
}

impl<'msg> From<&'msg [u8]> for Payload<'msg, '_> {
    fn from(msg: &'msg [u8]) -> Self {
        Self { msg, aad: b"" }
    }
}

hex::decode(&security.wrapped_dek).map_err(StoreError::Secret)?;\n\n    match security.mode {\n        KeyMode::Os => DataKey::from_bytes(dpapi::unprotect(&blob)?),\n        KeyMode::Password => {\n            let password = password.ok_or(StoreError::PasswordRequired)?;\n            let salt = hex::decode(\n                security\n                    .salt\n                    .as_deref()\n                    .ok_or_else(|| StoreError::Secret(\"口令模式缺少 salt\".to_owned()))?,\n            )\n            .map_err(StoreError::Secret)?;\n            let kek = derive_kek(password.as_bytes(), &salt)?;\n            aead_decrypt(&kek, &blob, DEK_AAD).map_err(|_| StoreError::WrongPassword)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 用新模式/新口令重新包裹同一个 DEK，就地更新 `security`。\npub fn rewrap(\n    security: &mut Security,\n    dek: &DataKey,\n    mode: KeyMode,\n    password: Option<&str>,\n) -> Result<(), StoreError> {\n    match mode {\n        KeyMode::Os => {\n            security.mode = mode;\n            security.salt = None;\n            security.wrapped_dek = hex::encode(&dpapi::protect(dek.bytes())?);\n        }\n        KeyMode::Password => {\n            let password = password.ok_or(StoreError::PasswordRequired)?;\n            let salt = random_bytes(SALT_LEN)?;\n            let kek = derive_kek(password.as_bytes(), &salt)?;\n            security.mode = mode;\n MiB / 2 轮 / 1 并行度），与 OWASP 推荐一致。\nfn derive_kek(password: &[u8], salt: &[u8]) -> Result<Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, StoreError> {\n    let argon = Argon2::new(argon2::Algorithm::Argon2id, Version::V0x13, Params::default());\n    let mut kek = Zeroizing::new(vec![0u8; DEK_LEN]);\n    argon\n        .hash_password_into(password, salt, &mut kek)\n        .map_err(|e| StoreError::OsKey(format!(\"口令派生失败：{e}\")))?;\n    Ok(kek)\n}\n\npub(crate) fn random_bytes(len: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>, StoreError> {\n    let mut bytes = vec![0u8; len];\n    getrandom::fill(&mut bytes).map_err(|e| StoreError::OsKey(format!(\"随机数生成失败：{e}\")))?;\n    Ok(bytes)\n}\n\n/// 输出 `nonce || 密文 || tag`。\npub(crate) fn aead_encrypt(key: &[u8], plaintext: &[u8], aad: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, StoreError> {\n    let cipher = cipher(key)?;\n    let nonce_bytes = random_bytes(NONCE_LEN)?;\n    let ciphertext = cipher\n        .encrypt(\n            Nonce::<Aes256Gcm>::from_slice(&nonce_bytes),\n            Payload { msg: plaintext, aad },\n        )\n        .map_err(|e| StoreError::OsKey(format!(\"加密失败：{e}\")))?;\n\n    let mut out = nonce_bytes;\n    out.extend_from_slice(&ciphertext);\n    Ok(out)\n}\n\n/// 输入 `nonce || 密文 || tag`；认证不通过时报 `Secret`，由调用方翻译成口令错误等语义。\npub(crate) fn aead_decrypt(key: &[u8], blob: &[u8], aad: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, StoreError> {\n    if blob.len() <= NONCE_LEN {\n        return Err(StoreError::Secret(\"密文长度不足\".to_owned()));\n    }\n\n    let (nonce_bytes, ciphertext) = blob.split_at(NONCE_LEN);\n    let cipher = cipher(key)?;\n    cipher\n        .decrypt(\n            Nonce::<Aes256Gcm>::from_slice(nonce_bytes),\n            Payload {\n                msg: ciphertext,\n                aad,\n            },\n        )\n        .map_err(|_| StoreError::Secret(\"认证失败\".to_owned()))\n}\n\nfn cipher(key: &[u8]) -> Result<Aes256Gcm, StoreError> {\n    Aes256Gcm::from_slice(key)\n        .map_err(|_| StoreError::Secret(format!(\"密钥应为 {} 字节\", DEK_LEN)))\n}\n\n#[cfg(windows)]\nmod dpapi {\n    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::LocalFree;\n    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::Cryptography::{\n        CryptProtectData, CryptUnprotectData, CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB, CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN,\n    };\n\n    use super::StoreError;\n\n    /// data.to_vec();\n        let mut entropy = ENTROPY.to_vec();\n        let in_blob = blob(&mut owned);\n        let entropy_blob = blob(&mut entropy);\n        let mut out_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB::default();\n\n        let ok = unsafe {\n            CryptProtectData(\n                &in_blob,\n                std::ptr::null(),\n                &entropy_blob,\n                std::ptr::null_mut(),\n                std::ptr::null(),\n                CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN,\n                &mut out_blob,\n            )\n        };\n\n        if ok == 0 {\n            return Err(StoreError::OsKey(format!(\n                \"CryptProtectData 失败：{}\",\n                std::io::Error::last_os_error()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        Ok(take(out_blob))\n    }\n\n    pub fn unprotect(blob_data: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, StoreError> {\n        let mut owned = blob_data.to_vec();\n        let mut entropy = ENTROPY.to_vec();\n        let in_blob = blob(&mut owned);\n        let entropy_blob = blob(&mut entropy);\n        let mut out_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB::default();\n\n        let ok = unsafe {\n            CryptUnprotectData(\n                &in_blob,\n                std::ptr::null_mut(),\n                &entropy_blob,\n                std::ptr::null_mut(),\n                std::ptr::null(),\n                CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN,\n                &mut out_blob,\n            )\n        };\n\n        if ok == 0 {\n            return Err(StoreError::OsKey(format!(\n                \"CryptUnprotectData 失败：{}\",\n                std::io::Error::last_os_error()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        Ok(take(out_blob))\n    }\n\n    fn blob(bytes: &mut [u8]) -> CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB {\n        CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB {\n            cbData: bytes.len() as u32,\n            pbData: bytes.as_mut_ptr(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 拷出系统分配的缓冲并 `LocalFree`——不释放的话每次解密密钥都漏一块内存。\n    fn take(out_blob: CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB) -> Vec<u8> {\n        if out_blob.pbData.is_null() {\n            return Vec::new();\n        }\n\n        let bytes =\n            unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(out_blob.pbData, out_blob.cbData as usize).to_vec() };\n        unsafe { LocalFree(out_blob.pbData as *mut _) };\n        bytes\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(not(windows))]\nmod dpapi {\n    use super::StoreError;\n\n    pub fn protect(_: &[u8]) Err(StoreError::OsKey(\"系统密钥库仅支持 Windows\".to_owned()))\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn password_mode_reports_wrong_password_instead_of_garbage() {\n );\n        assert!(matches!(\n            unlock(&security, Some(\"错一个字符\")),\n            Err(StoreError::WrongPassword)\n        ));\n        assert!(matches!(\n            unlock(&security, None),\n            Err(StoreError::PasswordRequired)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rewrap_keeps_the_same_dek_so_secrets_need_no_reencryption() {\n        let (mut security, dek) = Some(\"新口令\")).unwrap().bytes(), dek.bytes());\n        assert!(matches!(\n            unlock(&security, Some(\"旧口令\")),\n            Err(StoreError::WrongPassword)\n        ));\n    }\n\n assert_eq!(unlock(&security, None).unwrap().bytes(), dek.bytes());\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(windows)]\n    #[test]\n    fn switching_between_modes_preserves_the_dek() {\n        let (mut security, dek) = //! Listen and react to time.
pub use crate::core::time::*;

#[allow(unused_imports)]
#[cfg_attr(
    docsrs,
    doc(cfg(any(
        feature = "tokio",
        feature = "smol",
        target_arch = "wasm32"
    )))
)]
pub use iced_futures::backend::default::time::*;

use crate::Task;

/// Returns a [`Task`] that produces the current [`Instant`]
/// by calling [`Instant::now`].
///
/// While you can call [`Instant::now`] directly in your application;
/// that renders your application "impure" (i.e. no referential transparency).
///
/// You may care about purity if you want to leverage the `time-travel`
/// feature properly.
pub fn now() -> Task<Instant> {
    Task::future(async { Instant::now() })
}

NewSession(SessionKind),\n    DraftChanged(DraftField, String),\n    ToggleRevealPassword,\n    ApplyDraft,\n    ClearDraftPassword,\n    DeleteSelected,\n    OpenSelected,\n    ActivateTab(usize),\n Autosave,\n    DismissStatus,\n}\n\nimpl App {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        let paths = DataPaths::resolve();\n        let mut app = Self {\n            screen: Screen::Remote,\n Screen::Fatal(other.to_string()),\n        }\n\n        app\n    }\n\n    pub fn update(&mut self, message: Message) -> Task<Message> {\n        match message {\n            Message::ShowHome => self.show_home = true,\n            Message::ShowSettings => self.screen = Screen::Settings,\n            Message::SearchChanged(query) => {\n                self.search = query;\n                self.sync_rows();\n            }\n            Message::ToggleDirectory(id) => {\n                if let Some(store) = self.store.as_mut() {\n                    store.tree_mut().toggle(&id);\n Message::Autosave => self.save_now(),\n            Message::DismissStatus => self.status = None,\n        }\n\n        Task::none()\n    }\n\n    pub fn view(&self) -> Element<'_, Message> {\n        match &self.screen {\n            Screen::Unlock => ui::unlock::view(self),\n            Screen::Fatal(message) => ui::unlock::fatal(message),\n            Screen::Remote | Screen::Settings => {\n }\n\n    /// 有未落盘的改动时才挂定时器，空闲时不产生任何唤醒。\n    pub fn subscription(&self) -> Subscription<Message> {\n        if self.store.as_ref().is_some_and(Store::is_dirty) {\n    }\n\n    pub fn theme(&self) -> Theme {\n        theme::app_theme()\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn tree(&self) -> Option<&SessionTree> {\n        self.store.as_ref().map(Store::tree)\n    }\n\n .width(Fill),\n        ]\n        .spacing(6)\n        .align_y(alignment::Vertical::Center)\n        .width(Fill),\n    )\n    .on_press(Message::ActivateTab(index))\n    .width(Fill)\n    .height(Fill)\n    .padding([3.0, 8.0])\n    .style(theme::tab_label(active));\n\n    let close = button(text(\"✕\").size(11))\n        .on_press(Message::CloseTab(index))\n        .width(22.0)\n crate::app::{App, Message};\nuse crate::{theme, ui};\n\npub fn view(app: &App) -> Element<'_, Message> {\n    let sessions = app.tree().map_or(0, |tree| tree.session_count());\n\n    container(\n        scrollable(\n            column![\n                text(\"设置\").size(16),\n                ui::status_bar(app.status.as_ref()),\n                data_dir_card(app),\n                security_card(app),\n                text(format!(\"当前共 {sessions} 条连接、{} 条加密凭据\", app.secret_count()))\n                    .size(11)\n                    .color(theme::TEXT_DIM),\n            ]\n            .spacing(14)\n            .width(Fill),\n        )\n        .width(Fill)\n        .height(Fill),\n    )\n    .width(Fill)\n    .height(Fill)\n    .padding([16.0, 18.0])\n    .into()\n}\n\nfn data_dir_card(app: &App) -> Element<'_, Message> {\n    let path = app.paths.dir().display().to_string();\n\n    card(\n        \"数据目录\",\n        \"配置与会话保存在这个目录；改目录请设环境变量 SR_DATA_DIR 后重启程序。\",\n        row![\n            container(text(path).size(12).font(Font::MONOSPACE))\n                .padding([6.0, 8.0])\n                .style(theme::status_pill),\n            space_fill(),\n            ui::ghost_button(\"打开目录\", Message::RevealDataDir),\n        ]\n        .spacing(10)\n        .align_y(alignment::Vertical::Center),\n    )\n}\n\nfn security_card(app: &App) -> Element<'_, Message> {\n    let protected = app.key_mode() == KeyMode::Password;\n\n    let mode_line = row![\n        container(text(if protected { \"主口令\" } else { \"系统密钥库\" })\n            .size(11)\n
